Figure 2:Overview of ForceHarness, illustrated with one logged call.
Blue marks the command path and teal the force path.
The frozen model reads its inputs and returns one tool call, here asearchduring a USB-plug insertion.
The harness runs this call as a self-terminating force primitive that updates the target pose byEqs.2and3at every tick and stops on a contact event.
The inset sketches howsearchpresses withFdF_{d}and follows a spiral until the plug drops into the hole, while the photo and the force trace come from this call.
Beneath the primitive, the robot’s stock impedance controller turns the lead into force, and the bottom layer of ForceHarness estimates and re-zeros the hand force withEq.1.
The same harness drives a real arm and two simulators, and a fixed guard bounds what any primitive can do.
Fixed estimators turn the trace into physical quantities with uncertainties and flags, which return to the model as the tool result.

Figure 3:The three experimental settings, with one frame per task, cover six tasks on a real arm without a wrist force sensor, the eight tasks of ForceBench in Isaac Lab, and the seven tasks of HiddenPhys in MuJoCo. The colored zones in Weight and CoM are drawn for display only.

Figure C1:The seven tasks of HiddenPhys, each rendered from a recorded episode in MuJoCo. Hidden is what the seed draws and the model never sees, Told summarizes the instruction, Success is the check on the final state, and Expert is the script of the expert force controller with the constant that changes its outcome.

Figure E1:The web monitor while the robot runswiggleduring a USB-plug insertion.
The strip at the top lists the calls so far, the left column follows the current turn, and the right column plots wrist force and torque over the last 60 s.
The 8 N line guards free motion, so a force primitive may press above it, up to the 25 N cap.
The page replays the recorded episode ofFigureE2in real time.

Figure E2:The page of the same episode after it ended, with thesearchturn selected.
The operator interrupted the episode and labeled it a success by hand, so the page shows both a fault and a manual label, and the video panel is empty because the replay has no video.
